validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="iid"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><invoke id="i1" idlocation="iid" src="child.scxml"/><transition event="done.invoke.i1" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: invoke ID cannot use both `id` and `idlocation`
notes: `src`/`srcexpr`, `type`/`typeexpr`, `id`/`idlocation`, and an external source versus inline `<content>` are each mutually exclusive ways to say what to invoke and how to identify it
